defects.severity: low (defensive: the authority has the same size_t wrap, and this transcribed function is dead on the DER path)
defects.class: unchecked lenbytes + len used as the reserve extent in WPACKET_sub_reserve_bytes__ (AGENTS.md section 3)
defects.description: The authority passes the raw size_t sum to WPACKET_reserve_bytes. A wrapped sum would reserve fewer bytes than the subsequent allocate/write treats as available, so the crate must not reproduce the wrap.
defects.fix: lenbytes.checked_add(len); overflow answers 0, the authority's own reserve-failure outcome. Control: packet::tests::an_overflowing_sub_packet_extent_is_refused.
defects.divergence: For a pair whose sum wraps size_t the authority's result is undefined/implementation-defined; this crate refuses. No representable buffer reaches the sum.

defects.severity: low (defensive: requires a caller that cannot satisfy its buffer contract)
defects.class: unchecked pass_size + 1 used for two UI buffer allocations and for their cleansing extents (AGENTS.md section 3)
defects.description: do_ui_passphrase allocates pass_size + 1 octets twice and UiScratch::drop cleanses the same extent. A wrapped sum allocates a zero/short block while the UI is still told the buffer has pass_size octets.
defects.fix: pass_size.checked_add(1) before the UI is built; overflow refuses with the established invalid-argument site (PASSPHRASE_124). UiScratch stores the checked buf_size and uses it for both allocations and both cleansing releases.
defects.divergence: For pass_size == SIZE_MAX the authority proceeds with wrapped arithmetic; this crate refuses with the existing argument error. No representable buffer reaches the sum.

defects.class: callback-reported *pass_len trusted as a copy, cleanse and allocation extent; len + 1 unchecked (AGENTS.md sections 3, 17, 21)
defects.description: cache_passphrase reads the length an OSSL_PASSPHRASE_CALLBACK reported. A callback that claims success while reporting more than pass_size would make the authority read and cleanse beyond the caller's buffer and size the cache with a wrapped len + 1, then copy the overlarge length into it.
defects.fix: A match on len.checked_add(1) accepts only the Some arm with len <= pass_size; any other value cleanses the caller's pass_size bytes and answers 0, leaving no cache. Control: passphrase::tests::an_overlong_callback_length_is_refused.
defects.divergence: A contract-breaking callback is refused instead of trusted. The authority's undefined behaviour is not reproduced; a conforming callback observes no change.

defects.class: debug_assert!-only precondition on a copy extent (AGENTS.md section 21.4)
defects.description: vector_copy copied src.num_poly elements after debug_assert_eq!(dst.num_poly, src.num_poly). Under release the authority's assert disappears, so a shape mismatch writes beyond dst's block.
defects.fix: Release-level assert_eq!; a mismatch is a caller error and panics instead of writing out of bounds.
defects.divergence: The authority's NDEBUG out-of-bounds write is not reproduced; all in-crate callers construct equal-shape vectors.

retained_observations: src/rsa/gen.rs rsa_keygen_pairwise_test: plaintxt[plaintxt_len - 1] indexes without a local positivity check. The function is reached only after a successful key generation and pairwise_test is never set on this profile, so RSA_size() is positive on every reachable call; the precondition is recorded rather than changed.

src/x509/by_dir.rs get_cert_by_subject_ex: the path extent is the authority's int arithmetic strlen(ent->dir) + 17. BIO_snprintf truncates safely to the grown BUF_MEM and BUF_MEM_grow refuses a wrapped/oversized extent, so no out-of-bounds access follows for a path longer than INT_MAX.

src/ml_dsa/poly.rs matrix_as_slice: k * l is not checked. The dimensions come from fixed ML-DSA parameter sets; a wrapped product could only shorten the slice, not extend it beyond the allocated block, so it is not a memory-safety extent.
